description: List the people on the team: user_id, name, role (admin or member), avatar_url and a ready-made mention link; the result's team field names the team. Email addresses are never returned. Use it to mention someone in feedback_post / feedback_update content: [@Name](https://flask.do/members?user=USER_ID) notifies that person. query keeps names containing it; no match gives an empty list. It lists the whole team, not who can open an item: for an item's access settings, use permission_get.

query.description: Case-insensitive name filter (part of a name matches)

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

name: members
title: List members
